visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue sleeveless dress and white sneakers, walks across a lush green grassy field on Easter Island. In the background, a long row of massive Moai stone statues stands atop a stone platform against a clear blue sky with a bright, lens-flaring sun. (2) The scene transitions to a travel montage. The woman smiles at the camera on an airport tarmac with a large white LATAM jet behind her. She holds up travel documents, including a green passport and several receipts or boarding passes. Brief shots show an aerial view of a lush green coastline with circular white tanks and the deep blue ocean. (3) At a wooden building, a smiling woman in a floral dress places a flower lei around the main character's neck. The video shows the woman's accommodation, including a rectangular blue swimming pool surrounded by tropical trees and lounge chairs, followed by a cozy bedroom with a wooden wall and a clean bathroom where the woman takes a mirror selfie in a bikini. (4) A screen recording shows a website for "Rapa Nui National Park" ticket purchases. The woman then holds a paper ticket. She interacts with a male staff member wearing a blue shirt and black cap inside a rustic wooden booth, where he stamps a document or takes a payment. (5) The woman is seen with a male guide in a car; he wears sunglasses and a green hoodie. He later points to a map on a wall. There is a close-up of a small wooden Moai carving held in a hand with the actual statues in the background. The woman and the guide ride an ATV along a paved path by the sea. (6) At night, the setting shifts to a dimly lit indoor restaurant. Traditional dancers in elaborate feather headdresses and red/white costumes perform on stage. Musicians play guitars and sing into microphones. The woman is seen sitting at a table, eating with a fork, her face decorated with brown tribal paint patterns. (7) The woman participates in a wood-carving workshop. A man in a floral shirt uses a chainsaw to cut a log. The woman uses a chisel on a piece of wood resting on a stump. Later, the man helps her with the fine carving. The finished wooden Moai figure is shown held up against a blurry outdoor background. (8) Various food items are showcased: a pink ice cream cone held by a server, a colorful acai bowl with orange slices and seeds on a wooden table, and the woman biting into a piece of pineapple at an outdoor market stall under a blue canopy. (9) The final scene takes place at twilight. The Moai statues appear as dark silhouettes against a purple and orange sunset sky. The woman, now in a white shirt, dances and spins joyfully on the beach. She ends with a close-up selfie, smiling warmly as the sun is setting behind her.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 來一趟復活節島 四天三夜. [Subtitle]: 大概也花多少錢呢？. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次我是從智利出發. [Subtitle]: 機票來回約$1000. (3) [Subtitle]: 各位入境智利的PDI一定要收好喔. [Subtitle]: 因為移民官都會看. (4) [Subtitle]: 住宿三晚 $375. [Subtitle]: 我這次選的是一間有冷氣的. [Subtitle]: 超級完美. (5) [Subtitle]: 告訴大家復活節島真的很熱. [Subtitle]: 一定要找有冷氣. (6) [Subtitle]: 景點門票 $72. [Logo]: Rapa Nui National Park. (7) [Subtitle]: 來到復活節島一定要買的票. [Subtitle]: 知名景點都要靠這張景點門票. [Subtitle]: 才能入場哦. (8) [Subtitle]: 一日私人導遊 $200. [Subtitle]: 除了景點門票一定要買之外呢. [Subtitle]: 復活節島規定. (9) [Subtitle]: 一定要請導遊才能入景點. [Subtitle]: 請了一個私人導遊帶我趴趴走. (10) [Subtitle]: 傳統舞蹈秀 $35. (11) [Subtitle]: 在這裡一定要看一場傳統舞蹈表演. [Subtitle]: 而且你也可以順便在這邊. [Subtitle]: 吃一下晚餐. (12) [Subtitle]: 我真的是很適合這種海島國家. (13) [Subtitle]: 雕刻Moai體驗 $75. [Subtitle]: 路上你可以看到非常多的摩艾. [Subtitle]: 但是只有在這裡. (14) [Subtitle]: 可以雕刻自己的摩艾. [Subtitle]: 因為真的有點太難了. [Subtitle]: 所以說大多數時候. (15) [Subtitle]: 都是由師傅幫忙我雕. (16) [Subtitle]: 吃飯平均 $30~40. [Subtitle]: 所以我一天大概是吃了兩餐. [Subtitle]: 復活節島這邊的物價. (17) [Subtitle]: 會稍微高一點點. [Subtitle]: 所以平均餐費也會稍微的高. (18) [Subtitle]: 總共四天三夜 $1800~2000. [Subtitle]: 合計 $1997. (19) [Subtitle]: 如果說你們是兩個人一起來的話. [Subtitle]: 費用可能會不太一樣. (20) [Subtitle]: 為了來看摩艾石像. [Subtitle]: 我還是覺得非常值得拉.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat acoustic guitar track with a steady percussion beat begins. A young female voice narrates in Mandarin with a friendly, energetic, and clear tone, providing a cost breakdown. The speech rate is moderate and rhythmic. (2) At a transition, the BGM changes to include live traditional music. High-pitched female vocals and fast-paced rhythmic clapping/percussion from a live performance stage are heard. The narrator continues speaking over this layer. (3) The acoustic guitar track returns to the foreground. A sudden, loud mechanical roar of a chainsaw (incidental noise) interrupts the speech briefly, followed by the percussive, scraping sounds of wood being chiseled. (4) The narrator concludes the summary as the acoustic guitar music maintains a consistent tempo and volume. The audio ends with a gentle fade-out of the music and voice.
